snippet.title: Guardians of the Wild Sky - World Premiere Official Trailer | FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official world premiere announcement trailer for Guardians of the Wild Sky, which takes players on a fantastical journey through a world full of monsters and sky pirates, and features co-op online multiplayer. It's coming to PlayStation, Xbox and PC in Summer 2025. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #guardiansofthewildsky
